newsitem.title: CHILE: Airline LanChile mulls ADR issue.
newsitem.headline: Airline LanChile mulls ADR issue.

text.p: Chile's largest airline LanChile said its board will consider a capital increase, part of which may be raised abroad through American Depositary Receipts.

"The amounts and timetable in which this capital increase would be carried out are being studied by the administration, and will be submitted to the board for consideration in due course," the company said in a statement to the Stocks and Values Superintendency.
If the company goes ahead with its plans, it will be the 23rd Chilean firm to trade on Wall Street.
LanChile announced Friday that it had bought 99.4 percent of rival airline Ladeco for $38.4 million.

The airline bought San Alberto SA, a company linked to Lan's majority shareholders, and several investment companies which together owned 99.4 percent of LanChile. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
